rows.en: What on earth are we supposed to do!?
What on earth are we supposed to do!?
The energy generator is complete! Loading the Iga Crystal now!

Drag them into Genmu World…

Space Sheriffs, you will never escape Genmu World!
So you've come… you brats!
Demon King Psycho!
Let's go!
Doctor Polter! Activate the energy generator!
Energy generator, activate!
Demon King Psycho, fight me!
Holy sword!
Kyaooo! You have lost!
The Space Sheriffs' vision blurred, and the light panels on their chests began to flash erratically!
Don't give in, everyone!
The mechanisms of the Space Sheriffs' Combat Suits were struck with ultra-high-voltage current and began to go haywire!
Impudent brats! What do you take me for!?
Ugh…
Damn it, I won't lose!

…!?

Look! Sharivan!
The Iga Crystal…!?
The Iga Crystal drained an enormous amount of electricity, and Demon King Psycho's artificial brain lost its power!
Now!
So the Holy One was waiting for this moment…!?
We did it!
I-impossible… Am I to be defeated? I, the all-knowing and all-powerful…
Demon Kiiing! It's collapsing… the invincible Genmu Castle is collapsing! Uaaaah…
This is bad! Genmu Castle is falling apart! Everyone, get out!
I c-can't hold it together!? Genmu World, Genmu Castle… my power is fading…!? Nuoooh…
Madou has fallen…
Captain!
Yeah… We did it!
Gavaaan!
Mimi!
I missed you…
Jeez, you're so reckless!
But…
Showing off for us, are we…
Looks like Mt. Fuji's about to erupt…
Hahaha… Oh, sorry, sorry!

…!?

Commander Kom!
When did you come to Earth?
Mm… I just couldn't sit still after all…
Isn't this great, Mimi!
I thought I'd never see any of you again… That was the loneliest part.
You held out well…
The Holy One… and the Iga Crystal!?
The two lights are overlapping…
It's a guardian deity…
Eh…?
The Holy One is a guardian deity! The guardian of Planet Iga…
Then… the Iga Crystal is going to Planet Iga?
Yeah… It's beginning! The revival of Planet Iga…

Sharivan… there's something I need to tell you!

We had word from Rita! The Iga warriors who heard the good news of Madou's fall are gathering on Planet Iga one after another!
What!? On Planet Iga?
Mm… And one more thing!
"Give everything you've got to rebuilding Planet Iga!" Right? I know!
Wrong…
Huh?
As of this very moment, I appoint you sheriff in charge of the Planet Iga district!
Commander…
However… until the day the Earth's peace is assured, you'll also cover the Earth district!
The hard part starts now!

Yes… But I won't give in!

I promised Billy and Helen… that I'd protect the peace of this Earth, and rebuild Planet Iga.
I hope it becomes a planet overflowing with green, Planet Iga…
I hope it becomes a planet full of green, Planet Iga…
Yeah, thank you…
The space crime organization Madou was finally destroyed… The hearts of the battered Space Sheriffs were filled with the satisfaction of defeating a huge enemy.
But they face the next battle without rest! As if to say that strength is love… they give all of their own power to protect peace. That was the pride of the Space Sheriffs…
Having lost Bell Helen, the female warrior of Planet Iga, the warriors remained wrapped in deep sorrow as a month went by…
Defeat General Guiler, the Demon Beasts and all Fightlow soldiers!
Defeat Great King Gamagon, the Demon Beasts and all Fightlow soldiers!
Defeat Warrior Psycholer and all Gigants!
Any Space Sheriff is defeated
<c3>Mari</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
Waruder! When on earth will you bring me Kikaider 01's head?

Waruder!

A challenge letter from Zero-One has arrived, addressed to you! Surely… you don't mean to run away?

What!? A challenge letter from Lord Zero-One…?

Hmm… Whatever the outcome, I am resolved to fight no unseemly battle… Then, farewell!
Heh heh heh… Zadam, well done!
Because Waruder believed the letter, he fell right into my plan…

uncertain: U12353: 膤の電光板 read as 胸の電光板 "light panels on their chests".
U12363: Sharivan realizes the Holy One let the crystal be taken for this moment.
U12377/U12378: Den Iga and Lily tease Retsu and Mimi; 富士山が爆発しそう rendered as "Mt. Fuji's about to erupt".
U12386: narration-kind row with only a closing bracket; it is someone's line (likely Den Iga), speaker missing.
U12387: 折り貢なって read as 折り重なって "overlapping".
U12393: 鏡々 read as 続々 "one after another"; Rita per glossary (tokusatsu).
U12399: イガ星地区担当刑事 rendered "sheriff in charge of the Planet Iga district".
U12408: 体む read as 休む, 巳 read as 己.
U12410/U12411: 魔界獣 rendered "Demon Beasts" (glossary Demon Beast Gori Beast); 戦闘員ファイトロー as "Fightlow soldiers".
U12412: 能士サイコラー read as 戦士サイコラー "Warrior Psycholer"; 異て as 全て.
U12414: system message formatted like B0001.
U12417: 兒て read as 宛て "addressed to".
